A Regular Meeting of the City Council

Austin, Tex, Dec. 6, 1886.
Hon. J.W. Robertson, Mayor, presiding;
Roll Call present: Aldermen Brush, Campbell, Ervin, Walker, Warren, Wortham - 6.
Absent: Aldermen Anderson, Caldwell, Croaker, Cummings, DeGress, Giesen, Holman, Jones,
Metz, Odell, Pillow, Schneider, Schuler, Wellmer-14.
Alderman Brush moved to adjourn. Adopted. Milton Morris,
City Clerk.
